remarks: Welcome to this quiet and secure 12-unit elevator building in the heart of South Norwalk, complete with a private garage parking space and guest parking. One of the largest units in the building, this beautifully renovated 890 sq. ft. condo features new hardwood floors, an open-concept kitchen with quartz countertops and new appliances, and an expansive living and dining area with space for a home office. The oversized bedroom offers a generous walk-in closet, while central air conditioning and efficient gas heat provide year-round comfort. Enjoy an unbeatable walkable lifestyle just moments from everything SoNo has to offer, including The SoNo Collection, acclaimed restaurants, the South Norwalk Harbor, dog-friendly Oyster Shell Park, the newly renovated Maritime Aquarium, and the movie theater. Whether you're looking for a primary residence or an investment opportunity, this pet-friendly condo offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and location.

facts.laundryLoc: Lower level. Can install one in unit.
